faqs.question: How much does a wedding photographer and videographer cost in Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Our wedding photography is £750, our wedding film is £1,100, and photography plus film together is £1,650, saving £200. Each is one price for your whole wedding day, with no hourly packages.

faqs.question: Do you charge by the hour?
faqs.answer: No. We charge one price for the whole day and stay for as long as you need us, from getting ready to the dance floor.

faqs.question: How long until we get our photos and wedding film?
faqs.answer: Your edited photos and wedding film are usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks of your wedding.

faqs.question: How long is the wedding film?
faqs.answer: Your wedding film is usually between 3 and 6 minutes long, edited to capture the story and feel of your day.

faqs.question: How does the deposit work?
faqs.answer: We take half of the price upfront to secure your date. The other half can be paid whenever suits you, up to two weeks after your wedding.

faqs.question: Do you travel outside Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're based in Belper, Derbyshire, and work across the UK. We've filmed weddings in London a number of times.

faqs.question: Which wedding venues have you worked at?
faqs.answer: We've worked at Derbyshire venues including Shottle Hall near Belper and West Mill in Darley Abbey, as well as weddings in London.

faqs.question: Do you film adverts and commercial projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. We make adverts, promotional films, product photography and corporate event coverage for businesses. Every brief is different, so we quote per project.
